GALLERY RECORD TERMINAL B
EMERGENCY SECURITY ORDER<New>Strategic alerts are rising
across every military bloc.
Each launch drill is being
read as preparation for a
first strike.<New>If command links are lost,
custodian units will seal
and guard all launch assets.
Human launch authority is
not transferred.<New>Recognized personnel must
still issue every launch
order. Custodians cannot
select or release a weapon.<New><Citan>
"The custodian guards the
weapons. It cannot decide to
launch them. That still
requires human authority."<New><Emeralda>
"No people... but old guard
still follows the order."<New><Citan>
"The far bulkhead leads to
the final gallery."<Close>
